title: Summer marine heatwaves in the South China Sea
query: Using the supplied CMOMS daily temperature and velocity for 2011-2020, test the following findings of Yao and Wang (2021, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans, doi:10.1029/2021JC017792) on summer marine heatwaves in the South China Sea: (1) multiyear-mean summer marine-heatwave days and duration are concentrated near the Nansha (Spratly) Islands and in the Beibu Gulf; (2) marine-heatwave days, duration and frequency increased significantly over 1982-2020; (3) the leading EOF of summer marine-heatwave days has one sign over the whole basin and explains about 60% of the variance; (4) severe summer marine heatwaves occur when the southwest monsoon weakens south of 12 N and the upwelling in the mid-western South China Sea weakens or disappears. State your marine-heatwave definition and baseline, give a verdict for each finding (reproduced, partly reproduced, not reproduced, or not testable with the supplied data) with quantitative evidence, and explain differences from the paper, which used 1982-2020 satellite data.

paper.title: Variations in Summer Marine Heatwaves in the South China Sea
